title: Coins paired with tokenized stocks
summary: Coins from launchpads and projects that tie memecoins to tokenized stocks. STONK (StonkFun) says "Launch tokens / Backed by stocks", and @LaunchOnSF posted on 2026-10-16 that coins can now be launched paired with $MUSK4, a basket of TSLA, SPCX, NEURALINK and DOGE (e3:4). XSTOK says it lets users launch and trade tokens paired with stocks; @xstokfun posted on 2026-10-16 that xstok is open and pairs a coin with any stock on Raydium or Meteora (e3:3), and its pool was created about 14 hours before discovery. OTC says "Over-The-Counter Desks, earn stocks, pre-ipo, and yield", and @otc_labs posts daily revenue and the volume "across coins" ($98.33M on 2026-10-16, its own figure, e2:3). GTA VI (GTA6, StonkFun) says holders earn $TTWO stock by airdrop; a 2026-10-15 trader post counts 360K+ wallets receiving $31M of tokenized-stock rewards from Solana memecoins (e3:4). These are the projects' and traders' own claims: payouts, stock holdings and volumes are not verified, and no affiliation among the coins was checked. The Robinhood Chain stock-token coins (BORRO, IRIDIUS) and the AI-stocks meme BUBBLE are not counted. Measured: four coins across all their pools.

title: Nvidia CEO scandal coins
summary: Coins named for the Nvidia CEO story. The New York Times posted on X on 2026-11-08 at 20:10 UTC that Nvidia opened an investigation into its CEO Jensen Huang after he acknowledged to the board a relationship with a business executive whom U.S. intelligence determined to be a Chinese spy; an Axios post of the same evening links its report. Two coins are named The Nvidia Spy (Pump.fun and LaunchLab, symbol Alice), one Jensen Huang Coin and one Jensen Hung (Pump.fun). Dates from Codex: the Pump.fun Nvidia Spy pool opened on 2026-11-07 at 03:05 UTC, before the Times post; the LaunchLab one on 2026-11-08 at 20:19 UTC, nine minutes after it; Jensen Huang Coin on 2026-11-09 at 02:40 UTC and Jensen Hung at 04:12 UTC. A post says Nvidia found no evidence that company secrets were leaked; allegations are as reported in the posts and not verified here. None of the coins is shown to be connected to Nvidia, Jensen Huang or anyone in the story. Measured: four coins across all their pools.

title: Zcash launchpad coins

Sapling (SAPLING, Pump.fun): "the rootstock of SAPLING, the zcash launchpad on solana. 0.50% of every trade on every coin buys $SAPLING and burns it." Zcash Shielded Assets (Stamp, Pump.fun) has no description; its name is the story, and a Moonshot post of 2026-09-20 calls it verified there. BSC News (2026-10-29 05:50 UTC) says Zcash turned 10 on 2026-10-28; Snarks Pad posted "Happy birthday @Zcash $SNARKS" the same evening and sapling.cash posted on 2026-10-29 01:04 UTC that its launches now run on Raydium LaunchLab (e2:1, e3:3). Pools opened on 2026-09-20 (Stamp), 2026-09-25 (SAPLING) and 2026-10-11 (SNARKS). Fee, payout and burn claims are the projects' own and are not verified here; SAPLING was in an earlier narrative that was retired on 2026-10-03 at the cap.
